page_concerns.concern: Sends you to an unknown download site and installs with admin rights

steps.title: Download Zoom from an unofficial mirror
steps.explanation: Downloads an installer from a site that is not Zoom's own, then installs it with administrator rights. This is not recommended.
concerns: Downloads from an unknown website, not Zoom's official site
Installs software using your Mac's administrator password
Runs an installer you cannot verify is safe

steps.title: Install Zoom with Homebrew
steps.explanation: Installs the official Zoom app using Homebrew, a software installer already on this Mac. You may be asked for permission.

steps.title: Open Zoom
steps.explanation: Open Zoom from your Applications folder so you are ready for the video call.
